observation.happening: Home screen of a desktop AI assistant with Japanese UI, showing sidebar navigation and a greeting prompt asking what needs to be done. Calendar integration displays upcoming meetings (Google Meet at 10:00, Zoom at 13:30) and recent meeting notes.

observation.happening: Active meeting recording with a control bar showing timestamp and playback controls. observation.next_action: User must grant voice recognition permissions via the 'Open Settings' button, or continue with audio-only recording

Warning message in pink/salmon color stands out appropriately
